constraints.Roi_Namur: Secure status releases demand, not physical location. Ammunition, fuel, aircraft spotting cycles, landing-craft traffic and lagoon transit still gate reassignment.
constraints.Kwajalein: Until organized resistance collapses late 8-Feb, tanks, engineers, artillery observation, CVE spotting and close destroyer fires remain heavily committed.
constraints.ASW: Submarine contacts and previous LST/Cabot events prevent a wholesale reduction of outer escort and air-ASW even after the islands are tactically won.

centerline.late_morning: A limited northern-sector fire/observation wallet starts shifting toward Kwajalein or replenishment.
centerline.late_afternoon: As organized resistance collapses, two-to-four destroyer-equivalent direct-fire/support assignments and roughly one-to-two CVE-equivalent daily sortie wallets can begin transition toward replenishment, ASW or follow-on tasks.
centerline.guard: This is task-capacity release, not instant appearance at another battlefield and not a count of entire ships permanently detached.
